4-
5-Gebal is a Solidity review harness you run from a cloned repository with Codex, Claude Code, another assistant, or a local model. It pins the source and scope, prepares review context, validates AI observations, records evidence and keeps human decisions separate from model claims.
6-
7:The first iteration is a CLI and agent workflow. No Gebal account, website, hosted service or platform API key is needed. Original code is MIT licensed. Tool dependencies retain their own licenses. Brand domain: [gebal.ai](https://gebal.ai).
8-
9-## Tell your model to use it
10-
11-From your smart-contract repository, give your coding assistant this prompt:
12-
13-> Use https://github.com/Heesho/gebal as the harness for a defensive source review of this smart-contract repository. Read START_HERE.md and follow its workflow. You may set up and run the source-only workflow for this repository, keeping the harness, state and reports outside it. Use your current model, document the selected scope and assumptions, import your observations, and give me the Markdown/JSON reports. Ask before executing assessed code, calling an additional provider, expanding scope or modifying this project. Keep findings unreviewed for my triage and clearly state what was not checked.
14-
15-**Agent entry point: [START_HERE.md](START_HERE.md).** It covers cloning/setup, scope, approval, context export, review import and delivery. The assistant you already use performs the review; Gebal does not require a second AI account.
16-
17:**Version 0.2:** validated source-review workflow plus optional sandboxed Forge/Slither checks. Live fixture tests cover three compiler versions and nested monorepos. See [verification and limits](docs/verification.md). A project still needs an explicit scope, requirements and its pinned dependencies before a full tool run.

22-

25-cd gebal

73-## Add local tool evidence
74-
75:Set `sourceOnly: false` and optionally `existingTests: true` in your scope configuration. Supply a reviewed immutable tool image and re-plan/approve. See [sandbox preparation](docs/sandbox.md) and [monorepo scope](docs/monorepos.md).
76-
77-```sh
78:pnpm gebal doctor
79:# GEBAL_TOOL_IMAGE must be an existing local sha256 image ID or registry digest.
80-pnpm demo --tools
81-```
82-
83:Foundry and Slither run only inside the restricted local Docker sandbox. No network, host credentials, FFI, project package scripts or host-tool fallback. Missing Docker, missing images, unsupported config, failed compilation and unknown output stay visibly incomplete. Live fixture validation covers the pinned toolchain and three compiler versions in CI; a selected project still needs its own complete dependency scope and approved execution plan.
84-
85-Queue long-running checks for a separate worker:
86-
87-```sh
88-pnpm gebal run PLAN_ID --enqueue
89-pnpm worker
90-pnpm gebal status RUN_ID
91-pnpm gebal cancel RUN_ID
92-pnpm gebal resume RUN_ID
93-```

95-## Triage, reports and comparison
96-
97-```sh
--
105-
106-Decisions append to history. Reports separate severity, confidence, evidence type and owner disposition. Comparisons identify changed source and scope; they are partial and invalidate old findings rather than infer unchanged callers are safe. An empty findings list is not a security certificate.
107-
108:CLI exit codes: `0` command/planned checks completed; `2` configuration, approval or policy error; `3` failed/incomplete assessment. Enqueueing only confirms queue acceptance. Finding severity policy is distinct from execution success. CI examples must not reinterpret blocked analysis as a passing security gate.

110-## Optional direct API adapters
111-
112-If you prefer Gebal to make a bounded review request, OpenAI Responses and Anthropic Messages adapters are included. Set the appropriate key in the controller environment and add an explicit provider/model to the full scope config, then approve the new plan's source egress:
113-
114-```json
115-{"provider":{"provider":"openai","model":"YOUR_MODEL_ID","maxOutputTokens":2048},"limits":{"tokens":40000,"maxTasks":5}}
116-```
117-
118-No model is chosen or silently substituted. Keys never enter assessed source or containers. No consumer subscription is assumed to include API credits. Direct calls reserve token capacity and avoid retries when outcomes may be billable. Dollar pricing is unknown; external assistant usage is outside those enforceable limits. Provider transport tests use mocks; no live paid calls have been performed.
